Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Moments Chapel specializes in hosting beautiful wedding ceremonies and receptions in a charming and intimate setting. Our venue spans 6,000 square feet and can accommodate up to 120 guests, creating a cozy atmosphere for couples and their loved ones. We offer basic wedding services, including officiating, decor setup, and day-of coordination, while our catering is limited to light refreshments provided by a licensed third-party vendor. Alcohol service is restricted to beer and wine, with trained staff managing beverage service to ensure compliance with safety protocols. Our focus is on creating memorable experiences while maintaining strict adherence to safety, fire, and crowd control measures.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, a couple reported a slip and fall incident at our venue during a wedding reception. The cause was determined to be a spilled drink on the dance floor, which was not promptly cleaned up. The amount incurred for the claim was $5,000.00. The claim is currently in process with our insurance provider and the status is pending approval.
